subject.title: fix: preserve native trace heading typography

question: Should this protected, non-mergeable PR be repaired in place or superseded by an equivalent patch recreated from current main?
rationale: The implementation direction is clear, but the branch now overlaps extensive later Apple UI work and cannot be modified by maintainers through GitHub, so integration strategy requires owner judgment.

options.title: Recreate from current main
options.body: Apply the bounded semantic-profile implementation and tests cleanly to current main, compare it with this branch, and supersede the conflicted head.

options.title: Repair the existing branch
options.body: Have the branch owner rebase or transplant the commits, resolve the same-file conflicts, and request exact-head review again.

options.title: Pause for Apple owner
options.body: Keep the PR and linked issue open until the native Apple UI owner chooses the integration path.

recommendation.title: Recreate from current main
recommendation.body: Apply the bounded semantic-profile implementation and tests cleanly to current main, compare it with this branch, and supersede the conflicted head.
